senses.def: Awkward; unattractive; out of place; lopsided; misshapen.
ex: Look at me. Black as the Ace of Spades and ugly to match. . . . I catch sight of the obzocky black face in one of those fancy mirrors that these expensive hotels have all over the place, as if to spite people like me.
